page.notes: The page opens mid-word ("gistratus"), so the first paragraph is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The mark before "Q.VI." is an ornamental symbol, not a letter. Small printer's marks (strokes after "atque", "faciant") were left out. The last word is cut at the line end; the catchword "nis" completes it.
